_note: Pipeline decisions; see results/archive_audit/AUDIT_REPORT.md for the evidence behind them.

local_day._note: Forecast hours are fetched in UTC and grouped into IST calendar days. NASA POWER is requested with time-standard=LST (local solar time). Both day boundaries fall at night, so daily radiation totals are equivalent (audit: mean |LST-UTC| <= 0.001 kWh/m2/day).

splits._note: Chronological, by target_date (all lead rows of a date share a split). Test = last 12 months of NASA labels so both monsoons are held out. Proposed in results/archive_audit/AUDIT_REPORT.md.

climatology._note: Region x day-of-year NASA means from years strictly before the training period; circular +/- window smoothing.
